name: kompozr
description: KompozR's UI code in Kotlin's syntax, in kompoz! blocks of Rust sources and in .kt files: kompoz-lsp's language server (in front of rust-analyzer) and highlighting for the Kotlin

kompozr.server.path.markdownDescription: The `kompoz-lsp` to run as the language server. Empty: `KOMPOZ_LSP` from the environment, else `target/debug/kompoz-lsp` or `target/release/kompoz-lsp` in a workspace folder (the newest), else `kompoz-lsp` on `PATH`.

kompozr.server.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments given to `kompoz-lsp` after its own: rust-analyzer's, passed on to it.

kompozr.rustAnalyzer.path.markdownDescription: The rust-analyzer `kompoz-lsp` runs (`--rust-analyzer`, and `--shadow-rust-analyzer` for the shadow-project bridge). Empty: `rust-analyzer` on `PATH` (the toolchain's: `rustup component add rust-analyzer`).

enumDescriptions: `kompoz-lsp` stands in front of rust-analyzer unless the rust-analyzer extension (rust-lang.rust-analyzer) is installed, which then has the Rust to itself.
Always: `kompoz-lsp` runs rust-analyzer and answers for the Rust as well (turn the rust-analyzer extension off then, or the two answer twice).
kompozr.rustAnalyzer.mode.markdownDescription: Who answers for the Rust in `.rs` files: `kompoz-lsp` with the toolchain's rust-analyzer behind it, or the rust-analyzer extension.

kompozr.shadow.enabled.markdownDescription: The shadow-project bridge: a second rust-analyzer, started when first needed, over the Rust the Kotlin translates to, for rustc's type errors and type-accurate hovers on the Kotlin's lines. Off: `--no-shadow`.

kompozr.trace.server.markdownDescription: The messages between VS Code and `kompoz-lsp`, in the KompozR output channel.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:grammar
